arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_edges.py <<'EOF'
"""Edge cases: counter exhaustion, keyword names, refs transfer, big inputs."""
import json, struct, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

DENY = 4294967295
U32 = 4294967295
OK = {"ok": True}
REJ = {"error": "rejected"}
INV = {"error": "invalid"}
SVC = [{"name": "A", "label": 1}, {"name": "B", "label": 2}]
LIM = {"images": 16, "cells": 262144, "units": 1024, "contexts": 32768,
       "connections": 4096, "packets": 32768, "files": 8192}

def evs(events, services=SVC, limits=None):
    r = run_cli(req([job(services, events, limits)]))
    return r["results"][0]["events"]

def expect(name, events, wants, services=SVC, limits=None):
    check(name, evs(events, services, limits), wants)

# ---- counter exhaustion at U32 ----
expect("spawn gen exhausted", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, U32], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "exit", "unit": [0, 1, U32]},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, U32], "service": "A"},  # cannot increment
], [OK, OK, REJ])

expect("rid mark exhausted", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": U32},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": U32},   # mark exhausted
], [OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, REJ])

expect("stream mark exhausted", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, U32]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, U32], "stream": U32, "destination": "A"},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, U32], "stream": U32, "destination": "A"},
], [OK, {"ok": True}, OK, OK, REJ])

expect("stage epoch exhausted", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": U32, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": U32, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
], [OK, REJ])

expect("conn gen exhausted", [
    {"op": "open", "connection": [7, U32]},
    {"op": "close", "connection": [7, U32]},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [7, U32]},
], [OK, OK, REJ])

expect("file gen exhausted", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [3, U32]},
    {"op": "unlink", "file": [3, U32]},
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [3, U32]},
], [OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK, OK, REJ])

# ---- keyword-named services ----
KSVC = [{"name": "not", "label": 5}, {"name": "allow", "label": 3},
        {"name": "match", "label": 9}, {"name": "drop", "label": 1}]
# cols: drop=0, allow=1, not=2, match=3
expect("keyword names parse", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(match,not) allow; not(match(allow)) drop;"},
], [OK], services=KSVC)
r = evs([{"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(match,not) allow; not(match(allow)) drop;"}],
        services=KSVC)
im = r[0]["image"]
# words: (match,not) allowed; (allow) dropped; others denied unless matching... policy:
# allow iff w == (match,not) and w != (allow): so only (match,not)
check("keyword image", im, {"accept": [False, False, True],
      "rows": [[DENY, DENY, DENY, 1], [DENY]*4, [DENY, DENY, 2, DENY], [DENY]*4]})

# ---- store overwrite moves refs between images ----
expect("store overwrite moves refs", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 2, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},   # ctx in epoch 1
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 2},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2},   # ctx in epoch 2
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "file": [1, 1]},  # file ref ep1
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},                    # ctx ep1 + file ep1
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},                    # still file ref
    {"op": "store", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "file": [1, 1]},  # overwrite -> ep2
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},                    # ok now
    {"op": "inspect"},
], [OK, OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 2, "state": 0}, OK, REJ, {"ok": True, "allow": True}, REJ, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "active": 2, "images": [[2, 1, 3, 3]], "units": 1, "contexts": 1,
     "connections": 0, "packets": 0, "files": 1}])

# ---- clone inherits request mark ----
expect("clone inherits mark", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 5},
    {"op": "clone", "parent": [0, 1, 1], "child": [0, 2, 1]},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 5},   # mark inherited -> reject
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 6},
], [OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK, REJ,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}])

# ---- duplicate recv after exit ----
expect("recv duplicate after exit", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "service": "B"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "destination": "B"},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},
    {"op": "exit", "unit": [0, 2, 1]},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [0, 2, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 1, "wire": None},
], [OK, OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": struct.pack('>4s5I', b'EMC4', 1, 0, 2, 1, 1).hex()},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK, REJ])

# ---- wire with max fields ----
expect("wire max fields", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": U32, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": U32},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [U32, U32, U32], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [U32, U32, U32], "rid": U32},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [U32, U32]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [U32, U32, U32], "rid": U32, "connection": [U32, U32],
     "stream": U32, "destination": "B"},
    {"op": "recv", "unit": [U32, U32, U32], "rid": U32, "connection": [U32, U32],
     "stream": U32, "wire": struct.pack('>4s5I', b'EMC4', U32, 0, 2, U32, U32).hex().upper()},
], [OK, OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": U32, "state": 0}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": struct.pack('>4s5I', b'EMC4', U32, 0, 2, U32, U32).hex()},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": U32, "state": 0}])

# ---- policy whitespace forms ----
expect("whitespace forms", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A)\tallow;\r\nmatch(B)\x0c drop ;"},
], [OK])
expect("nbsp rejected", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A)\u00a0allow;"},
], [REJ])
expect("vertical tab rejected", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A)\x0ballow;"},
], [REJ])
expect("unicode in policy rejected", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(\u00e9) allow;"},
], [REJ])

# ---- five distinct non-match atoms ----
expect("5 distinct non-match", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "(contains(A) or contains(B) or contains(A,B) or endswith(A) or startswith(B)) allow;"},
], [REJ])
expect("4 distinct non-match", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "(contains(A) or contains(B) or contains(A,B) or endswith(A)) allow;"},
], [OK])

# ---- big input validation timing ----
import time
big = {"jobs": [{"services": SVC, "limits": LIM,
                 "events": [{"op": "inspect"}] * 200000}]}
raw = json.dumps(big).encode()
pad = b' ' * (24 * 1024 * 1024 - len(raw))
t0 = time.monotonic()
r = run_cli(raw + pad)
dt = time.monotonic() - t0
print(f"  24MiB input: {dt:.1f}s")
check("24MiB input ok", len(r["results"][0]["events"]), 200000)
check("24MiB input fast", dt < 60, True)
whole("24MiB+1 input invalid", raw + pad + b' ')

summary()
